requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL migrate confirmed valuable legacy interpreter capabilities before the old interpreter implementation is removed.

case.given: The old interpreter exposes async host, timer, and fiber orchestration semantics
case.when: The project prepares to retire the old interpreter
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide equivalent low-level pause/resume and scheduling capabilities independent of workflow checkpoint-only semantics.

case.given: The old interpreter exposes a table object system
case.when: Legacy interpreter capabilities are migrated
case.then: The project SHALL NOT migrate the old table object system as part of this capability-retirement work.

case.given: ExtensibleScopedRowType has a type system that is not yet migrated
case.when: Legacy interpreter capabilities are migrated
case.then: The project SHALL NOT implement or synchronize the type system as part of this track.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide legacy-compatible async host, timer, and fiber scheduling primitives using its instruction-stack and fiber-state model.

case.given: A script invokes a legacy-compatible async host operation
case.when: The host operation has not completed
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL suspend the waiting fiber without blocking unrelated runnable fibers.

case.given: A suspended fiber waits for an async host result
case.when: The host operation resolves or rejects
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL resume the saved continuation with either the result value or the matching failure path.

case.given: A script schedules a timeout operation
case.when: The timer is triggered by the host scheduler or mock scheduler
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL awaken the target fiber and continue from the saved instruction position.

case.given: A script schedules an interval operation
case.when: The interval fires multiple times and is later cleared
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL run each scheduled callback until the interval handle is cleared and SHALL NOT run callbacks after clearing.

case.given: A runtime instruction requests current fiber idle, suspended, or finalized state
case.when: The instruction is dispatched
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL update fiber state deterministically and select the next runnable fiber according to runtime scheduling rules.

case.given: A runtime instruction yields from one fiber to another fiber
case.when: The target fiber is runnable or explicitly awakened
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL switch execution to the target fiber and preserve the yielding fiber continuation.

case.given: Multiple suspended fibers are eligible to resume
case.when: The runtime awakens those fibers
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL transition each target fiber to a runnable state without losing their saved stacks or environments.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide a legacy-compatible reusable embedding callable mode for MakeFuncSync.

case.given: A host creates a callable with RuntimeInterpreter.MakeFuncSync without reusable mode
case.when: The host calls the callable repeatedly
case.then: The callable SHALL preserve existing RuntimeInterpreter default behavior.

case.given: A host creates a callable with reusable mode enabled
case.when: The host calls the callable repeatedly with different arguments
case.then: The callable SHALL reuse the intended runtime/function binding while isolating per-call operand and instruction stack state.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL migrate confirmed valuable legacy syntax sugar and compatibility aliases without changing current data syntax.

case.given: A script uses legacy prefix forms such as func, do, or main
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL map those forms to current function or block execution semantics.

case.given: A script uses legacy self-update operators such as --, +=, -=, *=, or /=
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL execute the equivalent read-modify-write behavior through instruction-stack expansion.

case.given: A script uses legacy JS interop aliases such as js_call or js_apply
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter executes the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL route the operation through the current host JavaScript bridge without depending on the old ExtensionRegistry.

case.given: A script uses legacy infix forms def_to, set_to, or save_operands
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the infix knot
case.then: The runtime SHALL execute equivalent definition, assignment, or operand capture behavior.

case.given: A script uses target chain assignment such as target.:field = value or target.:field := value
case.when: The left side is a writable property or subscript chain expression
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL treat the expression as object assignment compatibility syntax.

case.given: A source file uses equals in map entries, knot metadata, configuration fields, or other data syntax
case.when: The parser and RuntimeInterpreter process the source
case.then: The equals token SHALL retain its data-syntax meaning and SHALL NOT be interpreted as assignment.

case.given: A script uses common legacy host aliases such as Writeln, append, console, clear_interval, >=, or <=
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter executes the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL provide equivalent behavior or explicit host bridge mappings for those aliases.

requirement.statement: The project SHALL maintain a removal-readiness checklist for old interpreter code after migrated capabilities are covered by RuntimeInterpreter tests.

case.given: A legacy capability is migrated to RuntimeInterpreter
case.when: The old interpreter equivalent test or behavior is identified
case.then: The project SHALL add or update RuntimeInterpreter tests before deleting the legacy behavior coverage.

case.given: The migration test suite passes
case.when: The project prepares to remove old interpreter code
case.then: The project SHALL present remaining old interpreter logic for review before deleting it.
